custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with stock in one bin and a saved Min and Max.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, with stock.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 5.3 and 5.4 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839483-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839483-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • Part A's Total Qty cell reads "Not Tracked" in light grey plain text, with no coloured badge around it.
  • Part B's Total Qty cell shows a coloured badge with its quantity and the word Available.
  • Part A's Bin Location / Quantity cell still shows the outlined chip with its bin and quantity.
  • Part A's Min and Max cells still show numbers.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed, with the same grey "Not Tracked" text in Total Qty.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part), story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State)

  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”
  • S4-R8a: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Bin Location / Quantity column still shows each bin with its quantity.”
  • S4-R8b: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Min and Max columns still show the saved values.”
  • S6-R1: “Typing "not tracked", "not" or "tracked" in the Inventory search returns the untracked parts, together with every part those words match on part number, description, tags and the other standard fields. Upper and lower case, and spaces before and after the term, do not matter.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "5.3 The list says Not Tracked", "5.4 Finding untracked parts". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tracking-02-p5-3-list-not-tracked.png
  • tracking-03-p5-6-search-not-tracked.png

The design's own words:

  • “Total Qty reads "Not Tracked" instead of a quantity (S4-R8). Bin Location / Quantity still shows MZH1C with its 10 (S4-R8a), and Min and Max still show the saved values (S4-R8b). The Inventory Value report leaves the part out (S4-R9).”
